reason: Shipping a factory MVP requires native qualification and a factory replay. Enterprise and the workforce domain have independent gates.
An authenticated job must admit a supported plan, run it, independently check it and persist evidence.
The CLI can operate without an enterprise server.
Local solve needs planning and verification without any remote transport.
Only the hybrid binding needs both transports and explicit enterprise authorization.
Graph exploration consumes immutable incidence and cross-revision impact.
The complete integration review covers desktop, CLI, local, embedded and enterprise.
Research evidence can be published independently of later shipping gates.
